dialogues.speaker: Feiyun Slope Bulletin Board
dialogues.text: This is the Feiyun Slope Bulletin Board. You can find community news and shop advertisements posted here. Please do not post unimportant matters.

dialogues.speaker: Pearl Galley Announcement
dialogues.text: "Where pearled ladies bathe in the luxurious moonlight to the relaxing sound of the sapphire-blue waves."

dialogues.speaker: Pearl Galley Announcement
dialogues.text: "The Pearl Galley is the discerning gentleman's haven of leisure: a luxurious jade veranda lined with mood-setting lanterns; tables set with fine wines for the connoisseur and games for the betting man; the air filled with the sound of an elegant harp and ethereal flute; and, of course, beautiful women at your side to make the atmosphere even more perfect."

dialogues.speaker: Pearl Galley Announcement
dialogues.text: "Don't leave the fine wine and beautiful meal alone in the cold night wind."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Righto! Instead of breaking our backs all day to save money for 'important' things like medicine or education, let's just party and have no regrets in life! Wooo~"

dialogues.speaker: Reply
dialogues.text: "You have quite a spirit to you! I look forward to your visit to the Pearl Galley for a delight-filled night together."
